status: Frozen before numerical analysis; exploratory single-training-run study
scope: All six decoder blocks, six weight families Q,K,V,O,MLP-in,MLP-out; embeddings, LM head and norms excluded from main spectral claims.
primary_axes: Tensor-local C-order flattened real Fourier transform; MLP hidden-neuron axis Fourier transform for valid ordering tests.
checkpoint_differences: Each checkpoint minus initialization and each consecutive sampled checkpoint minus its predecessor. Unequal intervals reported as net displacement and net displacement per step, never gradient magnitudes.
recursive: Recursively partition each tensor-local rFFT frequency axis into 2,4,8,16,32,64 bands; preserve complex coefficients and phases for reconstruction. Repeated FFT of coefficients is not a new decomposition.
spectral_controls: Compare real orthonormal Fourier coefficient energy with real weight-coordinate energy; include matched Gaussian noise and valid random neuron permutations.
ordering: MLP in rows and in bias permuted jointly with out columns. No independent residual-stream shuffles. Native ordering is primary. PCA ordering fitted only to step2000-to-step4000 MLP updates, then frozen. Three fixed random permutations per layer. Sorting is a heuristic, not optimal alignment.
sparse_intervention: Step8000 model with MLP weight deltas from step4000 selectively restored. All non-MLP-weight parameters, including biases, remain at step8000. Compare native/random/PCA neuron-axis Fourier top-energy, native/PCA low-frequency, spatial top-energy and random spatial, at 10% and 25% real coordinate budgets. Selection uses the completed update and is retrospective, not sparse training.
behavior: 32 seeded unique-random-token sequences of length32 repeated twice, and shuffled-second-copy attention controls; per-head content-following attention, repeated-copy NLL and accuracy. Fixed original prose diagnostic set, not a benchmark or independently verified pretraining holdout.
validation: Check FFT Parseval and inversion, recursive band reconstruction, coherent permutation output invariance, endpoint restoration and all finite results; immutable checkpoint hashes recorded.
limits: One pretraining seed, six layers; no architecture/depth changes, no causal claim from spectral/behavioral coincidence, no grokking claim without train-versus-test evidence. Weight-axis frequencies are not token-position or semantic frequencies.
